original_gate: unchanged all 19 historical columns exactly identical; never exclude a column from historical byte gate

future_thread_control.mode: same VM, independent cold caches and subprocesses, original R4B5A.4 capture source, n12288 only
future_thread_control.BLAS_threads: set OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS/BLIS consistently; record actual BLAS threadpool and Numba parallel configuration; no assumption that serial @njit routines launch parallel reductions
future_thread_control.causal_rule: exact baseline matches historical in both repetitions and changed factor reproduces historical failed array exactly in both repetitions: evidence of reproducible factor effect in this VM; partial same columns or same ULP magnitudes alone not proof historical cause. No effect only excludes tested configurations. Check CPU/NumPy dispatch and harness differences separately if needed.

near_zero.rule: both magnitudes strictly below threshold at every mismatch point -> label NEAR_ZERO for those points; otherwise mixed/non-near-zero. No hard-gate exemption in this or future historical exact tests; an alternative numerical equivalence test would require separate protocol. Small normal values not denormal.

ulp.applies: where max(abs(a),abs(b))>=1e-30, report all exceedances. Thresholds prospective diagnostic only; no relaxation of exact historical gate.

synthetic: Existing gate is full native sampled C Linf versus analytic profile and exact-error orders, not merely nodal peak. Smooth interior peak permits O(h^2) sampling error in maximum value, but peak-location accuracy and subcell reconstruction are separate. Future report compare both native and concave three-point vertex against analytic r=sqrt(2), C=.9. Native sample below .9 is expected sampling, not a time-event NOT_REACHED; use NOT_REACHED only for unsupported time slices. Do not require sampled C to exceed analytic max.
environment_manifest: BLAS vendor/version/runtime and loaded library hashes
normalization: exclude documented address noise and unique cache path only, separately verify isolated cache receipts; no timestamp comparison

decision.ulp_exceedance: diagnostic investigation; no change to exact gate

limitations: Single-thread PASS not multi-thread production admission. Existing production unchanged. No DSS, AMR, 98304; all scientific holds remain.
